changelog: **Relation kind, employment attribution and funnel entry on `MentorshipRelation` (#1503, story #1502):** three additive columns — `kind` (`PLACEMENT` default | `COACHING`, VarChar so it can grow without an enum change), `employmentAttribution` (`THROUGH_US` | `SELF_FOUND` | `ALREADY_EMPLOYED`, NULL = not stated, read as THROUGH_US, never backfilled) and `funnelEnteredAt` (NULL → readers fall back to `startDate`) — plus `@@index([kind])`. Vocabulary and the hire-stage rule are pure in `src/lib/placementKind.ts` (default `HIRED_660`/`EMPLOYED_700` or the org's own last on-path stage, never an off-path one; unit-tested). `validateEmploymentAttribution()` sits next to the drop-off check in `src/lib/stageChange.ts`: a sent value must be on the whitelist, MARKETING orgs never carry one, and a missing attribution on a hire move is **not yet refused** (`EMPLOYMENT_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRED = false`) because no screen sends one — the UI change flips it. `PUT /api/mentorship/[id]` accepts `kind` (ADMIN only, 403 `kind_admin_only`; COACHING → PLACEMENT stamps `funnelEnteredAt`, the reverse clears it) and `employmentAttribution`; `POST /api/status-changes` stores a sent attribution on a live move into the hire stage; `POST /api/mentorship` accepts `kind` and the three creation paths set `funnelEnteredAt` for placements. No count changes: every existing row is PLACEMENT.
